answer: One concrete defense: make each identity earn trust at glacier pace. A newcomer posts a bond and accrues peer-attested work over many epochs, so standing climbs a slow ridge no attacker can shortcut. Spawning a thousand accounts then means funding a thousand bonds and authoring a thousand distinct answers, each as costly to craft well as composing an original sonnet. Sybils collapse because reputation cannot be minted, only mined over time.
